purpose: Independent check of requirements marked 'existing' against their acceptance criteria (founder instruction, 23 Oct). verified = a named test exercises the criterion; partial = some of it; gap = not met or not tested, with the fix.

Before: the settings record wasn't account-scoped, so tone, suggestions and natural voice carried to the next account. Fixed: settings scoped per account, language/theme/size device-wide; tests/settings-scope.test.mjs.

Before: two-tap removes existed but chat, file and reminder deletes did not say what stays. Fixed 0765a8b: each delete says what is kept (reminders and Library files after a chat; chats keep what Orivia read after a file; phone calendar copies after a reminder). tests/deletion-consequences.test.mjs.

Before: no way for a student to leave. Fixed 0765a8b: /api/me/orgs/:id/leave (confirm required, account header, sole admin must hand over, progress removed, audited) and a two-tap Leave control with an explanation. tests/leave-organisation.test.mjs (real Better Auth + SQLite; space 403 and chat context null after leaving). Rejoining uses the normal invitation flow.

Before: no university bookmarks existed (Ina 1f797f2: unverified). Built 16b8776: references only, membership re-checked each Library draw, Open reloads from the server, Ask through the server-checked context, title-only after leaving or removal. tests/org-bookmarks.test.mjs; docs/evidence/screens/lib-005-bookmarks-phone.png.

Before: other tabs reloaded on sign-in/switch/sign-out (BroadcastChannel) and the server refuses a mismatched account header (409 account_changed), but an unsent draft in the reloading tab was lost. Fixed: the draft is held under the account it was typed in (sessionStorage key by account id) before the reload and returns only to that account. tests/tab-account-switch.test.mjs; tests/device-accounts.test.mjs.

Roles come from server tables only: tests/organisations.test.mjs:119-120 (owner not inferred from email domain or request content), :49 (university email does not auto-enrol), :129-141 (no self-promotion, demotion takes effect next request); tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs (every staff route refused to students and other organisations' staff; owner routes refused to every organisation role).

Before: last-owner and sole-admin deletion were refused on the server (tests/organisations.test.mjs:108) but the app said only "That didn’t work", and no recovery procedure existed. Fixed: the account panel explains both refusals; no Worker route writes platform_roles; docs/owner-recovery.md (second owner, lost mailbox, private notes). tests/owner-recovery.test.mjs.

No impersonation or browse-everything route: owner overview and export carry no identities or private content, owner role is refused on every organisation staff route (tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs; tests/organisations.test.mjs:40 owner cannot list members); feedback queue excludes identity (tests/feedback.test.mjs).

New tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs: 181 hostile calls over every /api/orgs/:id route and method, the owner routes and the CSV export, by other-organisation admins and editors, students, pending members, the platform owner and signed-out callers, plus object substitution (own organisation id with the other organisation's content, member, invitation, request and code ids) and cross-site origin; all refused and organisation B's rows byte-identical afterwards.

tests/organisations.test.mjs:49,52 (verified university email and pending membership expose nothing), :105-106 (invitation secrets not accepted in URLs or by others), :72-76 (public codes are public content only; revoked code 404); joining requires staff approval before member content.

Context is a reference, re-read on the server for every request: tests/university-chat.test.mjs:47,50 (left or removed → readOrgContext null on the very next message), trial returns 403 org_context_unavailable before any model call, client clears the context and labels "Using <university>’s …".

No product analytics pipeline exists; Worker logs carry codes and counts only: tests/assistant.test.mjs:86 (assistant log holds outcome codes, not chat text or names), notifications/feedback logs are fixed codes (workers/accounts/notifications.mjs:43,64; feedback.mjs:59); feedback stores no identity in the owner queue.

Unavailable is never 0: tests/owner-overview.test.mjs:48-54,81-84 (missing budgets/feedback → unavailable/null), tests/metric-definitions.test.mjs (Paused/Unavailable documented; university dashboard says guide views and QR opens aren’t tracked and shows no rate).

tests/notification-client.test.mjs:8-11 (opening onboarding never prompts; Not now continues without a permission call; denied permission never subscribes; guests never asked); separate reminders/membership/updates preferences (tests/notifications.test.mjs:10-11) changeable in Settings.

tests/notification-isolation.test.mjs: a push carrying a visa appointment and passport number shows only fixed generic text; scheduler sends generic text (tests/notifications.test.mjs private title never on a lock screen).

Notifications carry no link: opening one always opens the app home, which re-checks sign-in, account and membership (app-sw.js notificationclick). New assertions in tests/notification-isolation.test.mjs: space, external and item URLs in notification data all open "/" only.

Gate held: production scheduled() delivers nothing and production push keys are empty (tests/notification-isolation.test.mjs:27-28). Enabling needs the founder approval, a real-device check and the disclosure version in the receipt.

Same-origin, session, account header and server roles on every route: tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs (direct endpoint attacks with manipulated ids, cross-site origin, mismatched account header), tests/organisations.test.mjs:86, tests/device-accounts.test.mjs, tests/files.test.mjs, tests/shares.test.mjs; account-specific storage (tests/account-client.test.mjs).

Human check before any chat (tests/myorivia-release.test.mjs:68), expired check keeps the agreement (:78), failed check shows the reason and Try again (tests/beta-start.test.mjs); per-person daily limit by salted hash and overall cap (tests/public-beta.test.mjs:57-65); assistant daily cap with retryAfter and provider spend limits (tests/research-pilot.test.mjs:99-103).

Text nodes for all user values (tests across chat-presentation, information-cards, place-card, content-details, shares with javascript: and <script> fixtures), CSV formula neutralised (tests/owner-overview.test.mjs:69-73); new tests/hostile-fetch.test.mjs: 20 private/numeric/local/credentialed/non-https/odd-port addresses refused without a request, off-host and downgrade redirects refused.

Before: switches existed but several off states were untested and there was no runbook. Fixed: docs/incident-controls.md (each switch, what stops, what people see, its test; rollback record and order of moves); tests/incident-switches.test.mjs (sign-in email, files, university spaces off: unavailable state, nothing sent/stored/read); research-off check added to tests/research-pilot.test.mjs.

tests/calendar-changes.test.mjs: proposals reviewed before applying, matching the intended reminder, ambiguity asks (AM or PM?), edit in place keeps unspecified fields, delete, Undo (refuses after a later edit), storage failure, and "I am lost"/"what?"/"quoi?"/Arabic never replay the earlier "Move the reminder to 12pm".

Before: an impossible date or time (30 February, 24:00) rolled over into another day instead of being refused. Fixed in zoneInstant. New tests/time-correctness.test.mjs: UK spring-forward gap shown as the real time (02:30 BST) before adding, repeated fall-back hour labelled GMT, Dubai day boundaries, unclear times refused, Dubai→London travel keeps the same moment under real device zones (TZ child processes); source zone shown in the review line (tests/university-actions.test.mjs).

tests/transport-assistant-card.test.mjs (chosen driving mode retained, encoded driving links), tests/device-handoffs.test.mjs (Apple and Google routes), tests/place-card.test.mjs (driving stays driving in both map apps, also when starting from the current location).

Before: no explicit current-location choice. Built without Orivia ever reading location: "Start from where I am instead" removes the starting point so the map app uses its own permission when opened, with a plain explanation and a landmark fallback; a route with no start says the same. tests/place-card.test.mjs (links, mode kept, toggle back, no navigator.geolocation anywhere in the app).

tests/transport-actions.test.mjs (no made-up numbers, broad origin asks), tests/transport-assistant-card.test.mjs (registered official source), tests/handoff-cards.test.mjs (sourced destinations only); no ETA, price or live arrival is produced without a source.

tests/handoff-cards.test.mjs:9-32: English, Arabic and user-language tabs (missing user-language version refused, not relabelled), large message, Listen in the selected language, Close stops speech and returns focus, nothing sent externally, no geolocation.

Microphone only on the dictation button (tests/dictation.test.mjs), photos/camera only through the file picker on tap, notifications only after an explicit choice and never blocking (tests/notification-client.test.mjs:8-11), location never requested by Orivia (tests/place-card.test.mjs). Declines leave typed chat and navigation working.

tests/assistant-timing.test.mjs (concurrent identical searches/pages deduplicated within a turn, bounded cache, request isolation, policy checks unchanged); one shared memberships request for menu, Home and Library (nav.js, reused 4 s, tests/navigation.test.mjs).

Replies are verified whole (verifyReply) before anything is shown; only activity lines stream, never reply text. tests/truthful-progress.test.mjs (no partial reply streaming), tests/assistant.test.mjs (rejected unsupported claim never displayed; corrected reply shown).

New tests/truthful-progress.test.mjs: a page that answered 503 is never counted as read, counts match what loaded, "Checking every fact against the sources" names the verification stage; progress labels carry no personal details (tests/assistant.test.mjs:164-165).

A goal with no reviewed guide gets no guide (tests/journey-intelligence.test.mjs:25,35,73-74 return null) and ordinary sourced chat help instead, so no false reviewed guide appears. Evidence-grounded personalised draft plans for uncovered goals are not built; tracked under JOURNEY-003.
tests/guide-cards.test.mjs: offer card with Follow guide / Save for later / Not now; Not now never saves; not offered again while following or after decline; refreshers only when asked.

The guide view now says what comes next (first unfinished step and its state) and what blocks the current step (earlier unfinished steps, each linked; a blocked note), and states that fees and timings appear only where the official source states them. Plans carry goal, city scope, applicability rules, ordered steps, sources with review dates, waiting-for and how-to-check from the reviewed journey data. Per-step owner and completion criteria are only as rich as that data (waitingFor, confirm); the generated journey data is not edited here. tests/plan-steps.test.mjs.

Built plan-steps.js: not started, in progress, waiting on me, waiting for them, blocked (with an optional note), done, not applicable, not sure, plus Ready shown when everything earlier is finished; every change recorded with time and source ("You marked this … · date"), Undo of the last change (refused if the step changed elsewhere since); older "waiting" saves migrate; server reads the same states. Done says it is the person’s own record, not an official approval. tests/plan-steps.test.mjs; browser check docs/evidence/screens/journey-004-step-states-phone.png.
"Ask Orivia about this step" prepares Chat with the guide and step named; context label, return-to-plan and account-switch behaviour still to verify.
Search and type tabs exist and filtered views never cross accounts (store is account-scoped). Missing: sort (recent / alphabetical / pinned) and filter by country/space. To build.

Files show "N of 100 MB used", refuse new uploads with allowance_full and a plain message (tests/files.test.mjs:57-60); device saves that fail say so and change nothing (tests/library-discoveries.test.mjs quota case, tests/calendar-changes.test.mjs storage failure); no eviction or truncation code exists.

Menus come from server roles and memberships only (tests/navigation.test.mjs:24-30 menuItems per role; spaces addressable; routes agree across app, /platform and /manage); every staff and owner route refuses other roles (tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs).
Keyboard, Arabic and 200% zoom checks run in the browser (docs/evidence/accessibility-browser-2026-10-23.json). Arabic at 200% zoom on a 390px phone still overflows by 27px in one place. To fix.

Failed loads show a sentence and a retry, never a blank card or fake number: spaces (tests/organisation-home.test.mjs:14 "couldn’t be loaded", Try again), owner overview (tests/owner-overview.test.mjs:81-84 unavailable/null), bookmarks (tests/org-bookmarks.test.mjs "Couldn’t check access"), files error messages (files.js ERRORS).

Keyboard-only flows through chat, versions, Library and settings with real key events (docs/evidence/accessibility-browser-2026-10-23.json, 5efd68d); pointer and touch paths covered by the UI tests (click handlers) and swipe tests (tests/week-swipe-links.test.mjs).

Slow or failed images fall back (tests/place-card.test.mjs img.onerror → illustration), missing voices fall back to the device voice or text (tests/listen-startup.test.mjs, tests/natural-voice.test.mjs), and there is no analytics dependency in chat or navigation.

The institution a person types stays their own unverified text (profile.place) and is never attached to an organisation; university membership only comes from an invitation plus staff approval (tests/organisations.test.mjs:49-56). School identity checks offer alternatives with sources (tests/school-sites.test.mjs).

Invitation welcome before sign-in, expired invitation refused, pending membership shows "Waiting for approval" with no content, personal use continues (tests/organisations.test.mjs:52,94; tests/organisation-home.test.mjs; tests/organisation-arrival.test.mjs institutional arrival kept separate from personal origin).

My Life and Settings reach profile, preferences, saved places, memberships, permissions and account deletion through menus; the account panel has "Download my personal data" (orivia-personal-export) — tests/consent-scope.test.mjs, tests/navigation.test.mjs.

Cards show only supplied contacts: university contacts render Call/Email/Website only for staff-supplied details (tests/university-actions.test.mjs), organisation cards only quoted values (tests/assistant.test.mjs:82-83), support requests are editable drafts never sent (tests/handoff-cards.test.mjs, STUDENT-007).
Editors draft, only admins publish (tests/organisations.test.mjs:43-48, editor publish by direct API 403), stale revisions refused with 409 (:47), arrival edits conflict-checked (:37).

A revision that drops required details is refused with a field-specific error (tests/content-details.test.mjs: contact with no method, date without a date, time without a zone, bad links; tests/organisations.test.mjs PATCH validation).

Built: updates take an optional Show until date and stop appearing for students after it (staff Overview lists ended updates); past key dates fold into a Past dates group without calendar buttons; staff can now edit existing content in the console (revision-checked), and editing a published date explains that students keep their own calendar copy until they choose to update it; a student whose saved copy is out of date sees both times and an Update my calendar button (nothing changes automatically; a new date in the past changes nothing). tests/dates-announcements.test.mjs; screenshot docs/evidence/screens/uni-006-edit-date-phone.png.

Generated QR codes decode to the exact join or public link (tests/organisations.test.mjs:29,50,68,71 decodeSvg = URL) on the configured origin; public codes open public content only; application records refused even to admins (:58).

Demotion and removal take effect on the next request (tests/organisations.test.mjs:139-143), every staff route re-checks the role server-side (tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs), so an old tab can’t publish or read.

Built: Settings tab (admins edit, editors read-only) for device-alert kinds the organisation may send, who students should contact (shown in the student space), service owners (active staff only), whether editors may download aggregate counts, and how long former members stay listed; Activity tab for admins (last 100 changes, areas not values, students anonymous); counts CSV (aggregate, formula-safe). Admin-only, recent sign-in, revision-checked, audited; unknown fields refused. tests/org-settings.test.mjs proves every other table is byte-identical after each change (no retroactive consent, no wider access, no cap changes); new routes added to tests/staff-tenant-matrix.test.mjs (209 hostile calls). Screenshot docs/evidence/screens/uni-015-settings-phone.png.

Spaces are addressable (/space/<id>), Back closes and reopens through popstate, deep links re-check membership and show "Space unavailable" otherwise (tests/navigation.test.mjs, tests/organisation-home.test.mjs, spaces.js followAddress).
Support requests are an editable email draft card that never claims submission (tests/handoff-cards.test.mjs; spaces contact Email opens mailto only).

Stage durations and codes logged (assistant metrics, tests/assistant-timing.test.mjs), request references for feedback (feedback request_id), provider error bodies never logged (tests/openai-pilot.test.mjs:37 rejects "Unsupported"/"Invalid redirect" text and prompts in logs).

The reading card says Orivia doesn’t check whether a document is genuine or valid (tests/files-to-chat.test.mjs:137); a person’s document never proves an official rule and figures must be in the document (:97-98).

Arabic sets dir=rtl app-wide (tests/i18n.test.mjs), week swipe is RTL-aware (tests/week-swipe-links.test.mjs), messages and inputs use dir=auto; Arabic browser checks in docs/evidence/accessibility-browser-2026-10-23.json (zoom overflow tracked under UX-005).
tests/dictation.test.mjs: dictation fills the box and never sends, errors keep typed text, stale sessions can’t write.

Automated: tests across focus, labels and live regions; browser keyboard/Arabic/zoom checks (docs/evidence/accessibility-browser-2026-10-23.json). Manual screen-reader spot checks on a real device remain with Ina (external: physical devices).

tests/assistant.test.mjs:174-183 (anxious newcomer with a housing scam: concrete steps, scam-aware, no generic disclaimer), tests/guide-cards.test.mjs (no nagging, offers not repeated), tests/research-follow-through.test.mjs ("yes please" continues without another permission question).
No subscription, paywall or payment code exists; onboarding and newcomer flows complete for guests and accounts (tests/onboarding-consent.test.mjs, tests/home-dashboard.test.mjs).

Before: the OpenAI provider consent, the document-reading acknowledgement and the university AI notice were stored device-wide, so a second account on the same device inherited the first person’s consent. Fixed: kept per account (accounts.js privateKeys); existing pilot accounts are asked once more. tests/consent-scope.test.mjs. Versioned consents and unticked defaults: tests/onboarding-consent.test.mjs:16, tests/research-pilot.test.mjs:67,95 (an old provider version is refused).

Evidence kinds stay separate in verification (official_rule, organisation_fact, person_document, community) with source labels (Official source / Organisation source / Source-backed); a person’s document can’t prove a rule (tests/files-to-chat.test.mjs:98); no blanket "verified" claim in the UI (chat.js:1394 note).

Demo organisations are labelled Demo; the app names OpenAI only where it is used, with consent; there are no store listings yet (blocked: Apple/Google accounts), so nothing claims a partner that isn’t configured.

tests/installable.test.mjs (manifest, icons, scope, install help, offline shell), tests/offline-updates.test.mjs (updates keep drafts, competing workers removed), tests/organisation-arrival.test.mjs (invite links keep the welcome flow before sign-in).
